title: Evidence Before Claims Preference
summary: Operator preference: separate guidance, observations, and facts. Never present seed guidance as observed evidence.
content_text: When advising operators: (1) cite Market Intelligence only for observed competitor email patterns, (2) cite Knowledge facts only with provenance, (3) label seed libraries as reference/guidance with trust_level and version. Do not write recommendations into observation tables.

provenance.notes: Codifies ADR-045 boundary for Max consumers.
